title: On the Julia sets of the non-autonomous iteration of exponential maps
summary: This paper studies non-autonomous iterations of $λe^z$, where at each step the parameter $λ$ is chosen from a bounded interval. Urbański and Zdunik introduced and developed a thermodynamic formalism for random dynamics of exponential maps, extending the autonomous result established independently by Rees and Lyubich to typical parameter sequences in $[A, B]^{\mathbb{N}}$ with $1/e<A<B<\infty$.
